Due to the confidential nature of the mandate, the company name and additional identifying details are being withheld . We have signed an NDA with the client and am currently working with them to assess the market and identify experienced Project Finance professionals who may be open to exploring a new opportunity. The Opportunity This is a senior-level opportunity for an experienced Project Finance professional to play a key role in financing and executing a growing portfolio of renewable energy projects. The VP will work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams across development, investments, legal, accounting, and commercial functions. Ideal Background The client is interested in speaking with professionals who have: 10+ years of relevant experience in Project Finance, Infrastructure Finance, Energy Finance, or a related field Strong experience executing renewable energy or infrastructure financings A strong understanding of project finance structures, debt, tax equity, and/or structured capital Experience managing transactions from initial structuring through financial close Experience working directly with lenders and other capital providers Excellent communication and relationship-management skills A track record of operating effectively in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment Confidentiality This is a confidential search. The client has specifically asked us to initially assess the market and understand who may be available and interested in considering a new opportunity. The company name and further identifying details will be shared selectively and only with qualified candidates as the process progresses. If you are a senior Project Finance professional within renewable energy and would be open to a confidential conversation about the market , please reach out directly. All inquiries will be handled with complete discretion.
